backup.production_rule: s111 (Lloyd 2026-11-08: the KPI tab shows average electricity and water per stay, ported from the admin Insights utilities chart). One function redefined, public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date): only the utility block changes (m3_month, m3_per_night, per_stay[].m3_per_night, per_month). No table, column, grant or row changes. Apply after the s110 release. restore_point is the backup used for the rehearsal; the orchestrator re-stamps both fields on the fresh backup taken before the apply.
backup.notes: Phase expand: a create or replace of one read function, no data written and no delete in the body. The old app ignores the new keys.

forward_verification.name: md5_kpi_tab_v1
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'b02b0612bb183f5876567aafd48e10c8' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: kpi_tab_has_stay_avg
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%per_month%' and prosrc like '%m3_month%' and prosrc like '%m3_per_night%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: kpi_tab_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: kpi_tab_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: kpi_tab_keeps_finance_gate
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%current_staff_authorized(''read_finance'', p_property_id)%' and prosrc like '%if v_fin then%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure

rollback.safe_until: Always: the script puts the s110 body of kpi_tab_v1 back exactly. The staff app of 3.4.27 hides the card when per_month is missing.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261113_s111_kpi_stay_avg.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; then md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) of kpi_tab_v1 must be fc58bc9881c5df2000fc459ef654ebed.

feature_flags.name: no_flag
feature_flags.required_state: None. Old clients ignore the new keys; the rollback script is the switch.

compatibility.evidence: Rehearsed on a restore of cascade-supabase-20261108T011533Z (disposable Postgres on the host alfred), chain s110 then s111: both migrations applied, forward checks 5/5, pgTAP s111_kpi_stay_avg.sql 30/30. Widening only: one read function redefined, only its utility block changed. Rehearsal restores with --no-acl, so grants are judged by the migration text plus the forward checks.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the rehearsal has not run the migration and s111_kpi_stay_avg.sql green on this commit, compatibility.verified is still false
the Opus 5.5 review of this SQL lane has not passed
the s110 release is not applied (the live kpi_tab_v1 md5 is not fc58bc9881c5df2000fc459ef654ebed)
